requirements.label: IB Diploma · New Zealand University Entrance
requirements.details: University Entrance uses the full IB Diploma with a minimum of 24 points. English Language A1 at HL or SL and an IB Mathematics subject satisfy the literacy and numeracy components. English Language B at HL with grade 5 is also accepted for literacy.

source.title: Auckland 2027 undergraduate prospectus · p. 91 · IB Diploma · New Zealand University Entrance

requirements.label: Cambridge International · New Zealand rank computation
requirements.details: Use up to six units of approved subjects, capped at two units per syllabus group. A level counts as two units, and AS as one. Thinking Skills is excluded. A-level grades A* through E earn 140, 120, 100, 80, 60 and 40 points; AS grades A through E earn 60, 50, 40, 30 and 20. The rank score is capped at 420.

source.title: Auckland 2027 undergraduate prospectus · p. 91 · Cambridge International · New Zealand rank computation

requirements.label: Cambridge International · University Entrance
requirements.details: University Entrance requires at least 120 New Zealand Cambridge tariff points and D or better from at least three eligible syllabus groups, excluding Thinking Skills, plus literacy and numeracy. Eligible A or AS English at E or above can satisfy literacy. IGCSE or GCSE Maths at D or above, or an AS Maths pass, can satisfy numeracy. The prospectus also recognises the applicable NCEA literacy and numeracy routes.

source.title: Auckland 2027 undergraduate prospectus · p. 90 · Cambridge International · University Entrance
